title.narrative: Preparation of Kyrgyzstan’s Initial Biennial Transparency Report (BTR1); and a combined Second Biennial Transparency Report (BTR2/NC5) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change

description.narrative: To support Kyrgyzstan prepare and submit First Biennial Transparency Report (BTR1) and a combined Second Biennial Transparency Report and Fifth National Communication (BTR2/NC5) that comply with the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) and Paris Agreement reporting requirements while responding to national development goals. This project will also support the preparation and submission of the Adaptation Communication under the Paris Agreement as a component of the BTR1 and the BTR2/NC5 as specified in Article 7 of the Paris Agreement and Decision 9/CMA.1.). At the national level, the project will allow for “built-in flexibility” if the country needs it in light of its capacities and national circumstances, priorities and needs, while bridging gaps identified.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
